vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Aisling showed Elvan the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Claire, Esteban, Donna, Elvan and Caoimhin met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Claire, Esteban, Elvan, Caoimhin are hurt.
Valeria showed Esteban the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Elvan showed Dale the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.

🛡️ Claire, Esteban, Donna, Elvan and Caoimhin met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Claire, Esteban, Elvan, Caoimhin are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Claire, Donna and Valeria met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Claire, Valeria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Claire, Dale and Aroha met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Claire, Dale, Aroha are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Valeria, Dale, Aroha, Hassan and Farid met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Valeria, Dale, Aroha, Hassan, Farid are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Dale, Aroha and Emma met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Dale, Aroha, Emma are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) and an eye-head (×8) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
You don't stroll through the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oanh just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
